title: Replaying the chant recording raises the temperature and brings an orb

tellings.quote: Temperature elevated and in that exercise an orb of light appeared in the homestead

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, says that playing back a recording of a chant inside one of its buildings, Homestead 2, made the temperature rise and an orb of light appear. He tells Michels he was part of it in the 2020s: 'Temperature elevated and in that exercise an orb of light appeared in the homestead.' If true, it would mean a sound alone could call something up on the ranch.
